seo.title: AquaVant | Adjuvants for fish vaccines in aquaculture
seo.description: AquaVant is an Oslo biotech company developing MicroVant, a series of adjuvants for fish vaccine manufacturers in global aquaculture.

hero.intro1: AquaVant develops MicroVant, a series of adjuvants that help fish vaccines work. We supply them to the companies that make the vaccines.

s2.statement1: We are an Oslo biotechnology company focused on one part of the fish vaccine: the adjuvant.
s2.soft1: It is the ingredient that helps a vaccinated fish’s immune system respond, and the field our founders have worked in for more than 45 combined years.
s2.text1: We do not make vaccines. We develop ready-to-use adjuvant formulations for the companies that do, and support them with advice on vaccine production, vaccination equipment and clinical trials.
s2.text2: Our first formulations are built for salmonids and tilapia, two of the largest groups of farmed fish.

need.heading1: Healthy fish need vaccines that work.
need.intro1: Disease is one of the biggest challenges in fish farming. Vaccines help prevent it, and the adjuvant is a critical part of every injectable fish vaccine.
need.text1: Preventing disease remains a major challenge for aquaculture worldwide.
need.text2: Where vaccines are hard to get, many markets still rely heavily on antibiotics.
need.text3: Adjuvant supply for fish vaccines is fragmented, so manufacturers have few dedicated partners to turn to.

mv.text1: A general injectable adjuvant formulation for a broad range of fish vaccines.
mv.text2: An injectable formulation developed for vaccines for salmon, trout and other salmonids.
mv.text3: An injectable formulation developed for tilapia vaccines, for one of the fastest-growing farmed species.
mv.text4: The next layer: proprietary formulations intended to make vaccines more effective.

work.intro1: Our customers are the companies that make fish vaccines. A partnership usually follows four steps.
work.text1: We start with your species, vaccine format and manufacturing needs.
work.text2: Joint formulation work and testing in your own R&D.
work.text3: Documentation, quality control and a secure supply chain.
work.text4: A commercial agreement for delivery of the adjuvant.

services.intro1: Beyond the adjuvant, we advise manufacturers on vaccine production, on equipment for manual and automatic vaccination, and on clinical trials in the lab and in the field.

team.intro1: Our founders have worked in fish health, immunology, R&D, regulatory affairs and commercialisation, at global animal-health companies and in aquaculture biotech.
team.focus1: Fish health and vaccine R&D, 25+ years
team.text3: species groups in focus: salmonids and tilapia

cta.text1: We would like to hear from vaccine manufacturers, aquaculture companies and investors.
